findings.claim: Global FREEZE does not itself close the canonical output-emission boundary for already STABLE/releaseable pipeline runs.
proof: Global transitionSystemState(error) persists global FREEZE and incident linkage but does not set PipelineRun accepted/releaseable/output fields.
emitAuthorizedPipelineOutput validates only per-run STABLE/accepted/releaseable/output/hash and does not validate current global SystemState.
GET /api/directives/:id invokes emitAuthorizedPipelineOutput when the per-run flags pass, without first rejecting global FREEZE/STOP.

DOC-E E9 forceCanonicalFreeze is followed by a separate recordPipelineRunFailure call before asserting runState=FREEZE and releaseable=false, confirming global FREEZE alone does not perform the per-run revocation.
findings.root_cause: Global availability/freeze authority and per-run release authority are not atomically coupled at the output emission boundary.
findings.blast_radius: FREEZE integrity, output release, API truth, incident handling, any previously STABLE unreleased output.
acceptance_evidence: Emission boundary fail-closes whenever durable/current global state is FREEZE or STOP.
Global FREEZE atomically prevents all pending output emission, including races with concurrent reads.
Negative race test proves STABLE output cannot emit after or concurrently with a committed global FREEZE.
